title: Night queue: studies that run while the laptop is left alone

jobs.name: swarm-dry
jobs.note: Swarm dry run again, after the timeout fix (local, £0); at most 90 min

jobs.name: ideate
jobs.note: Ask the agents for non-human ways of working together (~£0.15 Gemini + cents of DeepSeek)

jobs.name: bench-v1
jobs.note: Collaboration bench, first pass (~12-15 h over two nights, ~£5-7 Gemini); keeps finished cells

jobs.name: bench-v1-redo
jobs.note: Bench v1 again: only the broken cells of the first night (Gemini never answered as player from drawing repeat 2, nor as poem judge). Stops at once (exit 3) if a model doesn't answer; ~2-4 h, ~£1-2 Gemini

jobs.name: study-10
jobs.note: Swarm, full run (local, £0, ~8-9k calls: several nights, keeps finished cells). Off until the swarm thread has read the dry run and merged its changes

jobs.name: organise-pilot
jobs.note: The agents choose how to work together: solo, ours, L1, L3 with proposers Claude/Gemini/Codex/DeepSeek, Claude workers (~£0.35 Gemini proposer calls + cents of DeepSeek; ~10 h, keeps finished runs, may take two nights)

jobs.name: kata-pilot
jobs.note: Kata (study 14): improving an organisation round by round, new instance each round; arms fixed/free/kata/coach, Claude and Codex proposers, Claude workers (~£0, subscriptions; ~87 runs of ~5-6 min = ~8 h, keeps finished runs, may take two nights)
